def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x!=bg]
    colors=sorted({grid[r][c] for r,c in cells})
    # marker color: appears isolated points; shape colors form the pattern
    # pattern: contiguous shape = cells whose colors are not the marker
    # find marker = color whose cells are not adjacent to each other in a horizontal block of >1? 
    # simpler: pattern = the contiguous multicolor blob in input
    pos=set(cells)
    comps=[]
    seen=set()
    for r,c in cells:
        if (r,c) in seen: continue
        stack=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            p=stack.pop()
            if p in seen: continue
            seen.add(p); comp.append(p)
            r0,c0=p
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    q=(r0+dr,c0+dc)
                    if q in pos and q not in seen: stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    comps.sort(key=len, reverse=True)
    shape=comps[0]
    mr=min(r for r,c in shape); mc=min(c for r,c in shape)
    Mr=max(r for r,c in shape); Mc=max(c for r,c in shape)
    pat=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(mc,Mc+1)] for r in range(mr,Mr+1)]
    # anchor: find where the marker color sits relative? use demo knowledge: anchor index 2
    H=len(pat); W=len(pat[0])
    ar,ac=2,2  # offset of marker in demo pattern
    markers=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,x in enumerate(row) if x==bg and any(grid[rr][cc]!=bg for rr in range(max(0,r-1),min(len(grid),r+2)) for cc in range(max(0,c-1),min(len(grid[0]),c+2)))]
    # marker color = color of isolated single cells not in shape
    shape_set=set(shape)
    single=[p for p in cells if p not in shape_set]
    mc_color=grid[single[0][0]][single[0][1]] if single else None
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,x in enumerate(row):
            if x==mc_color:
                for i in range(H):

                        rr,cc=r+i-ar, c+j-ac
                        if 0<=rr<len(out) and 0<=cc<len(out[0]):
                            out[rr][cc]=pat[i][j]
    return out
